# E043 -- Targetti Brand Manual

## Metadata
- **Company:** Targetti
- **Industry:** Lighting / Design
- **Year:** Unknown
- **Source file:** targetti-brand-manual-en-pdf.pdf
- **Pages:** 76
- **Language:** EN (translated from Italian -- "Vetrofanie / adesivi" headings remain)
- **Pages sampled:** 1-2, 3-7, 12-13

## Brand Strategy
- Titled "Brand Manual 1.0" -- foundational identity document
- Logo described as the cornerstone of all communication
- Emphasis on consolidation and protection of Targetti's graphic image
- Strict adherence required: no changes to dimensions, colors, position, or ratios
- TOC structured: The Logo, Typesetting System, Corporate Colours, Corporate Identity, The Mood

## Logo
- Logo is the company name -- custom typeface, not a symbol
- Font is a graphic interpretation: interruptions/elimination of letter parts "suggest the passage of light" -- horizontal style
- Writing rule: "Targetti" (capital T, lowercase rest); never "TARGETTI" or "targetti"
- Clearspace: minimum 1/10 of logo length on all sides (15.7mm for 157mm logo)
- **7 incorrect-use rules:** no letter spacing changes, no stroke thickness changes, no height/width distortion, no vertical reassembly, no diagonal positioning (horizontal only), no colors other than black and white, no alternate typefaces
- Grayscale and color gamut versions available (pp.16-17)
- Can be used on photographic images (p.18)

## Typography
- **Corporate fonts** specified (p.20) -- details not in sampled pages
- **System fonts** specified (p.21) -- fallback fonts for digital/office use
- "Typesetting system" is a dedicated section

## Color
- **Black and Pantone Cool Grey** -- primary corporate colors (p.22-23)
- Very restricted palette -- logo limited to black and white only
- Color gamut system divided by product line: INDOOR, OUTDOOR, LOF (pp.56-68)

## Graphics
- "The Mood" section (pp.54+) with color gamuts organized by product line
- Three distinct mood/color gamuts: INDOOR, OUTDOOR, LOF
- Pattern/texture system not mentioned

## Photography
- Logo positioning on photographic images covered (p.18)
- No dedicated photography style section in sampled pages

## Applications
- Extensive corporate identity suite (pp.25-53):
  - Business cards, headed notepaper, window envelopes, open-end envelopes
  - Fax cover sheet, note pads, folders, "With compliments" card
  - Vetrofanie/adesivi (window stickers/adhesives), electronic signature
  - PowerPoint presentations, shopping bags, T-shirts, pencils, pens, USB flash drives

## Tone of Voice
- Not covered -- document is purely visual identity focused

## Outliers
- Logo design concept explicitly tied to the product (lighting): letter interruptions "suggest the passage of light"
- Extremely thorough stationery/collateral system (16 application types including USB drives, pencils, pens)
- Italian-origin brand manual translated to English with some Italian terms remaining (vetrofanie, adesivi)
- **Mood system** organized by product category (Indoor/Outdoor/LOF) is unusual -- color palettes tied to product lines rather than brand-wide
- Very strict logo rules (7 specific prohibitions) -- among the most restrictive encountered
- No year on the document

## Quality Score
- **3/5** -- Thorough traditional corporate identity manual with excellent stationery specifications and strict logo rules; the product-line mood system is distinctive; loses points for lack of tone of voice, limited photography guidance, and somewhat dated approach (fax cover sheets, no digital/social guidelines)
